Overview

PTIT provides comprehensive student support services to enhance academic success, wellbeing, and personal development throughout the student journey.

The Institute promotes a student-centered environment aligned with Outcome-Based Education (OBE) and Internal Quality Assurance (IQA) standards through:

  • Collaboration between academic faculties and functional departments;
  • Integrated digital learning systems and career service offices;
  • Compliance with international higher education quality benchmarks.
1. Academic Advising and Digital Support

Advisors and digital systems assist students in navigating their academic pathways:

  • Academic Advising: Support for study planning, course registration, and progression;
  • LMS & Digital Platforms: 24/7 access to e-learning systems and technical support;
  • Learning Resources: Continuous improvement of digital libraries and online databases.
2. Career Services and Financial Support

PTIT bridges the gap between education and employment while ensuring financial accessibility:

  • Employability: Internship programmes, job fairs, and employer networking;
  • Scholarships: Schemes for outstanding, talented, and disadvantaged students;
  • Industry Engagement: Collaboration with global enterprises for real-world experience.
3. Student Wellbeing and Campus Life

The Institute fosters holistic development through diverse extracurricular activities:

  • Holistic Care: Healthcare, counseling, and campus wellbeing services;
  • Student Engagement: Academic clubs, innovation hubs, and volunteer programmes;
  • Inclusivity: Specialized support for international students and mobility activities.
4. Student Feedback and Information Channels

PTIT values student voices and ensures transparent communication through surveys and advising channels.

For detailed information on student services, please visit: Student Support Services Link.
